parameters.name: overturn_api_key
parameters.helpText: A project API key from Overturn (Settings → API keys). Stored by Zendesk, never sent to the browser.

parameters.name: overturn_base_url
parameters.helpText: Your Overturn API URL when self-hosting. Add its host to the app's domain allowlist.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.helpText: The workflow name. One regression suite per workflow.

parameters.name: require_reason
parameters.helpText: Block the send until the agent picks a reason (one click) when they changed the draft. On by default: a changed decision without a reason is not a test.

parameters.name: capture_internal_notes
parameters.helpText: Also capture internal notes, not only public replies.

parameters.name: decision_fields
parameters.helpText: Custom fields that are the decision, as id:label pairs, e.g. custom_field_123:status, custom_field_456:reserve. Changes to these are scored exactly.

parameters.name: scope_tag
parameters.helpText: Optional. Only tickets carrying this tag are watched; every other ticket is never read, not even the reply box. Without it, every ticket's reply box is watched but nothing else is read until an AI draft appears.

parameters.name: min_draft_chars
parameters.helpText: Text inserted into the reply box in one go, at least this long, counts as the draft.
